gap: No result ChatGPT got states what a like-for-like kit costs today, meaning a 2 kWh rival station plus the same 200 W of panel priced from the maker's store, set against 4Patriots' $3,199 2200X-with-panel bundle. I could not source that figure today either, because every Shopify maker store (4Patriots, BLUETTI, EcoFlow, Jackery, Anker SOLIX US) returned HTTP 429 to my reads.
standout_why: I read three pages. powerstationgearlab.com (cited in 5 of 7 chats) prices 4Patriots units on 4patriots.com as of 2026-10-28 but prices its rivals (Jackery 2000 v2, Anker F2000, BLUETTI AC200L, Anker C1000) as station-only 'typical 2026' ranges, with no panel. powerstations.reviews/4patriots-solar-generator dates its 4Patriots prices 2026-11-03 and tells the shopper to check whether a rival plus a panel costs less than the dollar gap, but it does not do that sum. theoutagebrief.com prices the four 2 kWh rivals direct from the makers (2026-10-15 and 2026-11-02), says it computed no kit totals, and does not mention 4Patriots. I could not open solar-home.space's 4Patriots page for kit totals or 4Patriots prices and could not open solargenadvisor.com at all (certificate error). Our own current page already has an Elite 200 V2 + 200 W kit at $0.58/Wh, and chat 1 showed a BLUETTI kit near $1,199. So the bundle-to-bundle idea is only partly new, and I could not refresh the prices today.
decides: This confirms the pick and does not change it. Every 2 kWh rival in the set lists more continuous AC output than the 2200X's 2,200 W, except the Jackery 2000 v2, which equals it. Every rival also publishes a maximum solar input (400–1,000 W), which the 2200X does not, while the 2200X takes 12–14 h on its bundled 200 W panel per PowerStationGearLab. Based on 2026-10/11 rival-page prices, a rival station costs about $899–1,029, under a third of the 2200X bundle's $3,199, before any panel is added. That makes the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kit (5-year warranty, 1,000 W solar input, 2,600 W output) the likely lead. The kit price needs a same-day re-check on bluettipower.com before it is published.
